name: TUIO
description: Receive TUIO 1.1 multitouch (2D cursors) with multiple sources. Each touch frame / source gets its own container with stable touch slots, plus a combined All Frames container.

Touch Slots.description: Number of touch slots per frame (and in All Frames). A new touch takes the lowest free slot and keeps it until it lifts.

Invert Y.description: TUIO puts y = 0 at the top. Tick to make y = 0 the bottom.

Timeout.description: Seconds without any message from a source before its touches are cleared and it is shown as offline.

Clear Offline Frames.description: Remove containers for frames that are not currently sending.

Receiving.description: TUIO data received within the timeout
